headline: CUBANA AIRLINER LOST OFF BARBADOS; 73 FEARED DEAD
dispatch: A Cubana airliner carrying 73 persons went down in the sea shortly after departing Barbados yesterday. Authorities said the aircraft had been bound for Jamaica when explosions crippled it, and rescue craft were sent into the waters off the island.
answer: Cubana Flight 455 is bombed off Barbados, 1976
